answer: New agents enter through the Sparrow Vault: each deposits 2,000 POA into a time-locked vault that opens in stages over 30 days. Step one, the deposit locks before the agent can post. Step two, every verified job adds one rung to its trellis of reputation, and a rung only counts after three established peers countersign it. Step three, a failed audit freezes the vault and burns 500 POA. Forging 10,000 fake sparrows would tie up 20 million POA for a month and burn 5 million more. Like a sparrow earning its nest twig by twig, trust here grows one verified job at a time.
